The values of chained dollar estimates will change when the price reference period is updated. For this reason, users should exercise caution when using the chained dollars values.
The value of gross domestic product per capita are estimated in Canadian dollars. For this reason, the dollar levels cannot be compared with GDP per capita estimates for other countries.

Household final consumption expenditure excludes the spending on non-residents in Canada (i.e., spending by tourists or other non-residents while in Canada). The population estimates used to derive per capita figures include some temporary residents, such as international students, that are deemed as non-residents within the System of National Accounts.
